C0305.title: FBI Dismantles IoT Botnets Behind Massive DDoS Attacks
C0305.summary: U.S. federal law enforcement dismantled four IoT botnets—Aisuru, Kimwolf, JackSkid, and Mossad—responsible for a series of record-breaking distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks. The attacks leveraged a large number of compromised IoT devices to generate massive traffic floods aimed at paralyzing target services.
